name: NeverFall sell() redeems protocol liquidity pro rata to the pair's spot NF balance
summary: NeverFall.sell(amount) removes amount * pairTotalSupply / balanceOf(pair) of the protocol-owned USDT/NF liquidity and pays the seller a share of the USDT. After flash-loaned USDT bought most of the NF out of the pair, the pair's NF balance was tiny, so selling NF removed almost all protocol liquidity and paid the attacker far more USDT than the NF was worth.
notes: Immutable NeverFallToken runtime; owner calls before the exploit are whitelist entries, test buys and setStartBuy, which open trading without changing the redemption formula.

USDT that left protocol control: the attacker's net gain plus the 4,800 USDT flash-loan fee paid out of the proceeds. The 304,303.10 USDT routed to the protocol's own marketing wallet by the sell fee is not counted.
